project_type: Next.js 14 App Router full-stack application with mock data
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build to ensure TypeScript compiles and pages render. Run pnpm test for unit tests.
environment_constraints: All data is mock/local state. API calls fall back to hardcoded data. No real DB connection needed for features to work.
contribution_requirements: All new features must work with hardcoded mock data. All clickable actions must do something visible (update local state, show toast, open dialog, etc.)
key_patterns: Pages in src/app/*, components in src/components/<domain>/*. Uses shadcn/ui components, sonner for toasts, framer-motion for animations, recharts for charts. State is managed with useState hooks. Mock data is hardcoded in component files. Sidebar navigation in src/components/shared/sidebar.tsx.
directory_structure: src/app/ - pages (dashboard, accounts, groups, trades, metrics, settings). src/components/ - shared, dashboard, accounts, groups, metrics, trades, ui. src/lib/ - utilities, auth, prisma, trading types, validations.
